character.name: Idle
character.prompt:
Create a 32x32 pixel art side-view playable character for a 2D platformer.

A young Amazonian tribal warrior named Waraná, inspired by the Brazilian legend of Guaraná.

Strong and recognizable silhouette:
- Messy medium-length black hair.
- Brown skin.
- Red tribal face paint across the eyes.
- Simple red waist cloth.
- Bare chest and bare feet.
- Wooden spear with a stone spearhead.
- Athletic but slim body.
- Large expressive silhouette with oversized hair for readability.

Style:
- Clean pixel art.
- Limited color palette.
- High readability at 32x32 pixels.
- Minimal details.
- Suitable for sprite animation.
- Consistent proportions.
- Side view only.
- No background.
- No text.
- No lighting effects.
- No magical effects.
- No lightning.
- No floating orb.
- No glow.
- Transparent background.

Inspired by the readability and simplicity of Children of Morta, Moonlighter and classic indie pixel art.
